nodes.label: debugger Agent
nodes.rationale: Debugging specialist (Read, Glob, Grep, Edit, Bash, PowerShell) invoked proactively on stack traces, failing builds, analyzer/nullable errors, and broken tests. Its project gotcha list mirrors the repo's own: warnings-as-errors diagnostics, nullable reference types, per-project GlobalUsings, EF value converters for strongly-typed IDs, and MediatR pipeline order. Note its stale claim that there are no test projects.

nodes.label: Root-Cause Debugging Process
nodes.rationale: Capture, reproduce before changing anything, isolate to the smallest failing unit, form a specific hypothesis and confirm it rather than guess-and-check, distinguish symptom from cause and fix the cause, then re-run to prove the fix. Analyzer failures must be fixed cleanly rather than suppressed.
